scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npx tsc -p desktop/tsconfig.json
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run tools:verify && node scripts/electron-version.mjs && npm run desktop:build && npm --prefix desktop run dist && node scripts/clean-portable-releases.mjs
scripts.test:media: npm run build:shared && node --import tsx --test backend/test/local-media.integration.ts
